evaluation_coordinator_restart: Original evaluation coordinator stalled after 80k with no active or queued inputs reported; stopped that app and resumed 90k–100k evaluation on a new app. Training was unaffected; completed metrics reused.
volume_refresh_fix: A warm evaluator at the 90k→100k transition did not see the newly committed 100k checkpoint. Added run_volume.reload() at evaluation entry; final checkpoint reevaluated without retraining.
allocation_recovery: Stopped queued A10 and L4 apps; broadened allowed evaluation GPUs. Final successful allocation was A10.
